name: Fully-populated EPYC Genoa 12ch on a 405B Q4 model (derived feasibility number)
methodology: DERIVED, not measured. ~460 GB/s (12ch DDR5-4800 fully populated) / ~230 GB weights-per-token read -> ~1.5-2 tok/s expected on a 768GB Genoa/Turin box; recorded at midpoint 1.75. ik_llama.cpp fused MoE/AVX-512 paths worth ~1.9x on MoE decode over mainline.
notes: The one legit CPU-inference niche: a used Milan/Genoa box + ik_llama.cpp is the cheapest way to RUN a 400B-class model at all - batch/overnight-only speed, but it fits, which no consumer GPU can claim. RAM is the cost wall in 2026 (64GB DDR5 RDIMMs ~$873 -> projected ~$1,586). VERIFIED 2026-10-23 against https://runaihome.com/blog/cpu-vs-gpu-llm-inference-home-lab-2026/:
